title: Cascade protection timeline and synthetic shadow tests after rollout instability
creator: Jonah Kim
description: Summary: During a staged rollout of model:rfv-3b-quant-v2 we observed a cascading instability that began as increased P95 latency for a 2% canary cohort and escalated into a control-plane driven traffic shift. Root cause analysis shows a short-lived KV-cache eviction pattern on dedicated serving nodes (caused by variant kernel mismatch + sequence-length distribution) that caused bursts of CPU and memory, which in turn tripped the horizontal autoscaler. The autoscaler added capacity, traffic split logic rebalanced, and within a ~4 minute window the canary saw oscillating traffic percentages leading to client errors and a partial rollback that amplified the oscillation. Shadow traffic captured inconsistent KV warmup behavior between variants, which was not covered by our synthetic tests. This ticket captures the incident timeline, decisions, runbook changes, and action items to prevent recurrence.

decision_log: Adopted: Introduce a 'deployment timelock' (10m) for automated traffic ramping. Rationale: prevents autoscaler-driven oscillation from short-lived resource spikes.

Adopted: Add a synthetic shadow test job in nightly CI that exercises sequence-length multimodality and quantization-specific kernels. Rationale: reproduce warmup/eviction patterns before production canaries.
Deferred: Immediate hard rollback-to-zero on first P95 spike. Instead we will use tiered rollback thresholds with manual confirmation for >5% traffic impacts.
Adopted: Expand canary telemetry to include per-request kernel_variant and kv_cache_eviction_count for three minutes following variant activation. Rationale: surface kernel discrepancies early.
runbook_changes: Add new section: 'KV-cache eviction triage' with commands: kubectl -n serving logs --selector=variant=<id> | grep kv_eviction; and trace query: traces?filter=kernel_variant AND kv_eviction>0

Add explicit rollback sequence: 1) Pause traffic growth; 2) Pin traffic to previous stable variant (cli: redwood traffic set --route <route> --variant <stable> --percent 100); 3) Scale up stable variant by 1 replica before traffic switch; 4) Monitor 5m latency window; 5) If errors persist, open incident and execute full rollback playbook.
Add 'Post-deploy synthetic shadow' run: run synthetic-shadow --variants <candidate> --duration 10m --patterns long,short,mixed --report-path /tmp/ENG-70491-shadow.json
